units: all coefficients of X and r in units of 1/(16 pi^2); X_1 = sum X[name] N_name; Delta S^(1)_ST = sum r[name] Q_name

summary.X_outside_span_N: none: every component of X_1 is a monomial of tab:Nbasis; X_1 lies in b(span Q) (solve residual ~1e-15)
summary.WZ: b X_1 = 0 on all 34 ghost-number-2 leg classes; non-trivial (term scale > 1e-9) in ccV, ccVV, ccSS, ccFF_f, ccFFV_f, ccFFS_*: max |bX|/term scale = 3.4e-14; the other classes vanish term by term
summary.anomaly_SM: all epsilon components of X_1 vanish (coefficients prop. to D^{abc} = 0); numerically sum_f X_eps^f = 1.6e-13 vs single multiplet 1.4e2
summary.anomaly_general: X_anom = -(1/3) int D^{abc} eps^{mu nu rho sigma} omega^a d_mu A^b_nu d_rho A^c_sigma + (1/12) int D^{aed} fg^{bce} eps^{mu nu rho sigma} (d_mu omega^a) A^b_nu A^c_rho A^d_sigma; with D^{ABC} = D_GGG g_s^3 d^{ABC}, D^{BBB} = D_BBB g'^3, D^{B a b} = D_Brr c_r^2 g' delta^{ab}: X_anom = -(1/3)[D_GGG N_(eps d) + D_BBB N_(eps B) + sum_r D_Brr (N^(r)_(eps B r r) + 2 N^(r)_(eps r B))] + (1/12) D_GGG N_(eps d f) + sum_r (D_Brr/12)(N^(r)_(eps r B f) - N^(r)_(eps 4 B)); b X_anom = 0 per multiplet; modulo b(Q^(r)_(B eps), Q^(r)_(4 eps)) four independent directions remain; with Delta S supset -sum_r D_Brr [(2/3) Q^(r)_(B eps) + (1/4) Q^(r)_(4 eps)] the remainder is -(1/3) D_GGG N_(eps d) + (1/12) D_GGG N_(eps d f) - (1/3) D_BBB N_(eps B) - sum_r D_Brr [N^(r)_(eps B r r) + (1/3) N^(r)_(eps 4 B)] (no non-abelian ghost in the mixed part); it is not b-exact unless all four D vanish
summary.existence: X_1 = 0 in omega omega rho~, omega omega rho~ A, omega omega omega zeta, omega omega sigma H (both orders); coefficients of N^(O_k)_(Y B) and N^(O_k^dagger)_(Y B) are 0 (k = u, d, e); (N4) admits the solution; (N4') gives the identical solution
summary.ccRF_internal_ghost: without the g1_ccRF part (C_ad^(r)/4)(N_RR^{frr} + Nbar_RR^{frr}) no solution exists (least-squares residual 0.42 relative); with it the residual is 2e-15
